description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Rakdos Carnarium.
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
